thread:
Eleni: Quick follow-up to routing RFC: I propose an "admission" phase that filters by region/tier/model-family before scoring. Keeps scorer pure and reduces adapter branching. Thoughts?
Sam: Sounds promising. Admission removes incompatible routes early?
Eleni: Yes. Simple boolean predicates only; cache metadata in resolver (TTL 20s).
Jorge: Watch the tail: add an escape hatch if admission > 2ms then skip and mark admit_skipped.
Priya: Need compact explain codes for ops + a staged rollout: shadow -> soft-deprioritize -> hard-admit.
ops-bot: perf-run: cache hit 98.9%, avg admit latency 0.9ms, p95 end-to-end -5.6% when candidate set 50.
Sam: Agree. I can update sim harness. Jorge: telemetry?
Jorge: I'll add admit_reject_by_code, admit_latency_ms, preempted_count.
Eleni: I'll draft an addendum with API shape (candidates CSV + admit_summary CSV) and predicate registry. Target review tomorrow.
